Priyanka V: Quick follow-up from the INC-2099 postmortem. We observed a repeating pattern where KV shard warming fails under short, high-QPS spikes and operators manually flush caches which causes cascades. Need owners for runbook edits (including exact safe commands), the escalation fast-path, and a small automation to detect the pattern and suggest the playbook. Who can take what?

Joel M: I can take the runbook edits. Will create a concise "first-7-minutes" checklist + safe command snippets. Will avoid recommending flush as first action. ETA 4 business days.

Farah (SRE): I'll own the escalation fast-path and alert tuning. Proposal: if p95 latency > 2s OR kv_cold_start_rate > 3x baseline for 2m -> page oncall-primary; no ack in 4m -> page secondary and DM infra-leads. I'll add the exact Slack template for the pager. Opening ticket now.

Ben K: I can prototype a tiny detector (scheduled job) that scans incident logs and flags the burst+kv_cold_start pattern and posts a suggested playbook snippet. Prototype will be a CLI that outputs a suggested checklist file to the runbooks repo. ETA 2 weeks to ship a PoC.

Priyanka V: Joel / Farah / Ben please paste PRs/ticket links back here. Also we need a remediation owner for the config hotpatch: auto-shrink batch_size when cold_start_rate spikes and pre-warm policy for 10m. Prefer separate owner for implementation vs. rollout.

Joel M: Runbook items I'll include:
```
# safe checks before any flush
POD=$(kubectl -n inference get po -l app=inference-runtime -o jsonpath='{.items[0].metadata.name}')
kubectl -n inference logs $POD --since=5m | egrep -i "kv_cache|kv_warm|cold_start"
# check kv metrics (non-destructive)
kubectl -n inference exec $POD -- curl -fs localhost:9100/metrics | egrep "kv_hit_rate|cold_start_count"
# prefer scale-up before /admin/kv/flush
```
I'll add a short decision tree and quick rollback steps.

Farah (SRE): Ticket created: https://jira.redwood.ai/browse/INC-2099-ESCL 1. I'll add the Slack pager text and the ack/escalation windows. Also I'll adjust the staging alert rule to test it.

Ben K: Prototype CLI repo created: https://git.redwood.ai/r/tools/kv-pattern-detector/pulls/1 1. It currently scans the incident log bucket and emits a suggested runbook fragment; will add a mode to auto-open PRs after review.

Priyanka V: For the hotpatch (config remediation) who volunteers? Need owner for implementation and separate owner for rollout/testing.

Joel M: I can own the implementation (control plane change that reduces batch_size and toggles pre-warm). Will need DevOps review. ETA 10 business days for staging.

Farah (SRE): I'll own the rollout/testing and monitor smoke runs. I'll create a staging test that injects a 20s burst and asserts kv_hit_rate >= 90% within 30s.

alert-bot: Reminder: follow-ups for INC-2099 are due in the incident tracker by 2026-06-01.

Priyanka V: Action recap (so tracker aligns):
- Runbook "first-7-minutes" + commands: Joel M  due 2026-05-28, PR to runbooks repo.
- Escalation fast-path + Slack pager text: Farah (SRE)  due 2026-05-25, ticket INC-2099-ESCL.
- Detector PoC (suggested playbook snippets): Ben K  PoC PR link above, due 2026-06-08 for MVP.
- Config implementation (auto-shrink batch + pre-warm): Joel M  due 2026-06-10 for staging.
- Rollout & smoke tests: Farah (SRE)  due 2026-06-15, will link results.

Joel M: PR opened for runbook draft: https://git.redwood.ai/r/inference/runbooks/pulls/245  includes decision tree and safe commands. Feedback welcome.

Ben K: Updated PoC: https://git.redwood.ai/r/tools/kv-pattern-detector/pulls/2  added a runbook fragment generator.

Farah (SRE): Staging alert ticket: https://jira.redwood.ai/browse/INC-2099-ESCL created and linked to tracker.

Priyanka V: Thanks everyone. Please keep this thread posted with PRs/ticket updates and any blocker notes. We'll mark the incident tracker when items are merged and the smoke run is green. If anything slips, call it out here. :white_check_mark:
